notes.title: New Option: Hide "Buy Chips" Button Until Balance Reaches a Configurable Amount
notes.content:
We've added a new "Show 'Buy Chips' Button" configuration option to the Preferences page. You can now choose when the 'Buy Chips' button appears by setting a chip amount threshold. To adjust this setting, head to "Preferences" from the main menu.

[h2]Change Log[/h2]

[h3]1.1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new configuration option to the Preferences page to show 'Buy Chips' button under a particular balance amount.
[*] Fixed bug where Sound Effects Volume was not being applied at game startup.
[/list]
